ProgramUnit.Name: GET_PARM_SELECT
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
procedure get_parm_select is
/*
 If report parameter values already exist, then they are brought in
 by execute_query. Otherwise, the defaults are brought by a cursor
 fetch.
 If the report has no parameters, then the parameter entry block is
 skipped & user can enter submit parameters.
*/
 cursor c1 is
 select b.report_name,
 b.parm_no ,
 a.parm_code ,
 a.parm_prompt ,
 a.code_type ,
 a.ref_table ,
 a.ref_column ,
 a.default_value ,
 a.list_form_name
 from rpt_parm_code a,
 rpt_parm_def b
 where report_name = :ctrl_block_1.report_name and
 a.parm_code = b.parm_code and
 a.appl_id = b.appl_id and
 a.appl_id = :ctrl_block_1.appl_id
 order by parm_no;
------------------------------------------------------------------------
begin
 go_block('parm_select');
 :system.message_level := '10';
 execute_query;
--
 if :system.block_status = 'NEW' -- no records found
 then
 :global.block_status := 'NEW';
--
 for c1_rec in c1
 loop
 :parm_select.report_name := c1_rec.report_name;
 :parm_select.user_name := :banner.user_id ;
 :parm_select.parm_no := c1_rec.parm_no ;
 :parm_select.parm_id := :rpt_parm.parm_id ;
 :parm_select.parm_code := c1_rec.parm_code ;
 :parm_select.parm_prompt := c1_rec.parm_prompt;
--
 :parm_select.code_type := c1_rec.code_type ;
 :parm_select.ref_table := c1_rec.ref_table ;
 :parm_select.ref_column := c1_rec.ref_column;
 :parm_select.default_value := c1_rec.default_value;
 :parm_select.list_form_name := c1_rec.list_form_name;
--
 if c1_rec.code_type in ('DATE','DATETM')
 then
 if substr(c1_rec.default_value,1,7) = 'SYSDATE'
 then
 :parm_select.parm_select :=
 to_char(sysdate,'MM-DD-YY');
 if NVL(length(c1_rec.default_value), 0) > 7
 then
 :parm_select.parm_select :=
 to_char( to_rrdate
 (:parm_select.parm_select,'MM-DD-RR')
 + to_number(substr(c1_rec.default_value,8,15))
,'MM-DD-RR') ;
 end if;
 end if;
 else
 :parm_select.parm_select := c1_rec.default_value;
 end if;
 down;
 end loop;
 --
 first_record;
 if :parm_select.parm_code is null
 then
 :parm_select.parm_prompt :=
 '*** No Parameters For This Report ***';
 set_default_flags;
 GO_ITEM('RPT_PARM.SUBMIT_FLAG');
 end if;
 end if;
 --
 :global.block_status := 'OLD';
end;

ProgramUnit.Name: START_REPORT_GEN
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
procedure start_report_gen is
 parameters VARCHAR2(150) := NULL;
 command VARCHAR2(200) := NULL;
 header_flag VARCHAR2(5) := NULL;
 batch_queue rpt_report_names.batch_queue%type;
begin
--
 select
 '-a' || :ctrl_block_1.appl_id || ' ' ||
 '-t' || :report_type || ' ' ||
 '-r' || :rpt_parm.report_name || ' ' ||
 '-p' || :rpt_parm.parm_id || ' ' ||
 '-u' || :banner.user_id || ' ' ||
 '-q' || decode(:rpt_parm.auto_print_flag,'N','NONE',
 decode(:rpt_parm.print_id,
 NULL, nvl(:ctrl_block_1.print_id,'NONE'),
 :rpt_parm.print_id )) || ' ' ||
 '-f' || decode(:rpt_parm.forms_type,
 NULL,nvl(:ctrl_block_1.forms_type,'NORMAL'),
 :rpt_parm.forms_type ) || ' ' ||
 decode(:rpt_parm.header_and_trailer_flag, 'Y','-h') || ' ' ||
 decode(:rpt_parm.delete_after_print_flag, 'Y','-d') || ' ' ||
 '-n' || to_char(:rpt_parm.no_of_copies) || ' ' ||
 '-c' || :global.chapter_id
 into parameters
 from dual;
--
 command:=' nohup'|| ' repgen.sh '|| parameters || ' > /dev/null &';
 if :ctrl_block_1.batch_queue is null and
 :rpt_parm.submit_after_time is null
 then
 null;
 else
 select 'echo "' || command || '" | at ' ||
 decode(:ctrl_block_1.batch_queue,NULL,NULL,
 '-q'||:ctrl_block_1.batch_queue || ' ' ) ||
 decode(:rpt_parm.submit_after_time, NULL, 'now',
 to_char(:rpt_parm.submit_after_time,'HH24:MI DD MON YYYY'))
 into command
 from dual;
 end if;
--
-- message (command);
 host ( command );
 if form_failure
 then
 message ('Err: Submit report failed ');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end if;
end;

ProgramUnit.Name: VALIDATE_PARM
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
procedure validate_parm is
 t_date date;
begin
--
------------------- parameter must be entered ---------------------
--
 if :parm_select.parm_select is null
 then
 message ('Err: Parameter value must be entered ');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end if;
--
------------------- skip validation, if paramter = ALL -----------------
--
 if :parm_select.parm_select = 'ALL'
 then
 return;
 end if;
--
------------------- validate wrt field type ------------------------
--
 if :parm_select.code_type = 'NUMBER'
 then
 begin
 if check_numeric (:system.cursor_value) = FALSE
 then
 message ('Err: Parameter value should be numeric ');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end if;
 end;
 elsif :parm_select.code_type = 'DATE'
 then
 begin
 if NVL(length(:system.cursor_value), 0) = 6
 then
 :parm_select.parm_select :=
 substr(:system.cursor_value,1,2) || '-' ||
 substr(:system.cursor_value,3,2) || '-' ||
 substr(:system.cursor_value,5,2);
 elsif NVL(length(:system.cursor_value), 0) = 8
 then
 null;
 else
 raise value_error;
 end if;
 t_date := to_rrdate(:system.cursor_value,'MM-DD-RR');
 exception
 when others then
 message ('Err: Invalid date format. Must be MM-DD-YY');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end;
 elsif :parm_select.code_type = 'DATETM'
 then
 begin
 if NVL(length(:system.cursor_value), 0) = 10
 then
 :parm_select.parm_select :=
 substr(:system.cursor_value,1,2) || '-' ||
 substr(:system.cursor_value,3,2) || '-' ||
 substr(:system.cursor_value,5,2) || ' ' ||
 substr(:system.cursor_value,7,2) || ':' ||
 substr(:system.cursor_value,9,2);
 elsif NVL(length(:system.cursor_value), 0) = 14
 then
 null;
 else
 raise value_error;
 end if;
 t_date := to_rrdate(:system.cursor_value,'MM-DD-RR HH24:MI');
 exception
 when others then
 message
('Err: Invalid datetime format. Must be MM-DD-YY HH:MI');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end;
 elsif :parm_select.code_type = 'ODATE'
 then
 begin
 if NVL(length(:system.cursor_value), 0) = 7
 then
 :parm_select.parm_select :=
 substr(:system.cursor_value,1,2) || '-' ||
 substr(:system.cursor_value,3,3) || '-' ||
 substr(:system.cursor_value,6,2);
 elsif NVL(length(:system.cursor_value), 0) = 9
 then
 null;
 else
 message ('Err: Invalid date format. Must be DD-MON-YY');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end if;
 t_date := to_rrdate(:system.cursor_value,'DD-MON-RR');
 exception
 when others then
 message ('Err: Invalid date format. Must be DD-MON-YY');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end;
 end if;
-------------------------------------------------------------------------
 if :parm_select.ref_table is not null and
 :parm_select.ref_column is not null
 then
 begin
 select decode(instr(:system.cursor_value,'%'),0,'N','Y')
 into :parm_select.wildcard_ind from dual;
 end;
--
 user_exit ('rptcheck');
 if form_failure
 then
 if :parm_select.err_msg is null
 then
 :parm_select.err_msg :=
 'Err: Checking paramater wrt ref table';
 else
 message ( :parm_select.err_msg);
 end if;
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end if;
 end if;
end;
